Ugly Chocolate Omelette
By: Sandeea Cocina
Published: Friday, April 1, 2011 - 1:09pm

Ingredients




2 large eggs
75 grams sugar
75 grams chocolate chips
1 pinch of salt
6 grams of pure cocoa powder

Preparation

1 Beat eggs, add sugar and cocoa, mix well, and finally add the chocolate chips. 2 Put two tablespoons of sunflower oil into a small pan and heat it over medium-high heat. 3 Pour in the mixture you've just prepared. Stir occasionally like scrambled eggs, until the omelette begins to set. 4 Turn the omelette with a dish, and let it cook on the other side. Use a big flower cookie cutter to shape the omelette. It can be served hot, cold or warm with an scoop of ice cream, custard ...
